detail.title: 4MP Smart Dual Light Fixed-focal Dome WizSense Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-HDBW3449F-AS-IL 4MP Smart Dual Light Fixed-focal Dome WizSense Network Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 4 MP Resolution • Smart Dual Light: Built-in IR and LED Lights with 3 Illumination Modes Supported • Enhanced Deep Learning-Based Human and Vehicle Classification • Xinghan Vision Models: Comprehensive Enhancement of Target Detection, Imaging • AcuPick Enables Fast and Precise Human&Vehicle Search • Built-in Mic for Real-Time Audio Security • IP67 and IK10 Ratings for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: 0.005 lux@F1.6 (Color, 30 IRE) 0.0005 lux@F1.6 (B/W, 30 IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on)
General.Illumination Distance: 2.1 mm: Up to 20 m (65.62 ft) (IR); Up to 20 m (65.62 ft) (Warm light)2.8 mm: Up to 30 m (98.43 ft) (IR); Up to 30 m (98.43 ft) (Warm light)3.6 mm: Up to 40 m (131.23 ft) (IR) Up to 40 m (131.23 ft) (Warm light)
General.Angle Adjustment: Pan: –30° to 30° Tilt: 0° to 80° Rotation: 0° to 360°
General.DORI Distance: LensDetectObserveRecognizeIdentify2.1 mm 50.6 m( 166.01 ft) 20.2 m( 66.27 ft) 10.1 m( 33.14 ft) 5.1 m ( 16.73 ft)2.8 mm 61.6 m( 202.10 ft) 24.6 m( 80.71 ft) 12.3 m( 40.35 ft) 6.2 m ( 20.34 ft)3.6 mm 78.0 m( 255.91 ft) 31.2 m( 102.36 ft) 15.6 m( 51.18 ft) 7.8 m ( 25.59 ft)*DORI (Detect, Observe, Recognize, Identify) is a standard system (EN-62676-4) for defining the ability of a person viewing the video to distinguish persons or objects within a covered area. The numbers in this table do not reflect intelligent function distances. For intelligent function distances, refer to installation and commissioning manual/project design tool.
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Intrusion, tripwire (the two functions support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human), stay detection, loitering detection. Offers Perimeter Protection Large-Scale AI Models to extend the target detection range and reduce the rate of false alarm.
General.AcuPick: Uses deep learning algorithms and works with back-end devices to accurately match targets, such as people and motor vehicles, and search through live and recorded videos to quickly locate targets.
General.AI SSA: Adopt deep learning algorithms to adjust the parameters of the image to suit the conditions.
General.Face Detection (Full Image): Face detection; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload; face exposure; face snapshot set as face or one-inch photo; snapshot strategies (real-time snapshot, quality priority and optimization snapshot); face angle filter; optimization time setting.
General.Smart Search: Work together with Smart NVR to perform refine intelligent search, event extraction and merging to event videos
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (Only supported by sub stream)
General.AI Coding: Super AI Coding (H.265); Super AI Coding (H.264) *Includes smart codec technology, Smart H.265+ and Smart H.264+
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 2688 × 1520@(1–25/30 fps) Sub stream: 1920 × 1080@(1–25/30 fps) Third stream: 1920 × 1080@(1–25/30 fps) *The values above are the max. frame rates of each stream; for multiple streams, the values will be subjected to the total encoding capacity.
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 3 kbps–16384 kbps; H.265: 3 kbps–16384 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; Natural; Street Lamp; Outdoor; Manual; Regional Custom
General.Alarm Event: No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; illegal access; motion detection; video tampering; tripwire; intrusion; scene changing; audio detection; voltage detection; face detection; loitering detection; stay detection; people detection; motor vehicle detection; SMD; security error
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; QoS; UPnP; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; SAMBA; PPPoE; SNMP; P2P
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S & Profile G & Profile T & Profile M); CGI
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (support max. 512 GB); NAS
General.Management Software: Smart PSS Lite; DSS; DMSS; DoLynk Care
General.Security: Video encryption;Firmware encryption;Configuration encryption;Digest;WSSE;Account lockout;Security logs;IP/MAC filtering;Generation and importing of X.509 certification;syslog;HTTPS;802.1x;Trusted boot;Trusted execution;Trusted upgrade;Session security;Security warning
General.Certifications: CE-LVD: EN62368-1; CE-EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU
General.Alarm Input: 1 channel in: supports wet contact connection (max load 5 mA 3–5 VDC); supports dry contact connection
General.Alarm Output: 1 channel out: wet contact, max load 300 mA 12 VDC
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 3.3 W (12VDC); 8.3 W (PoE); Max.: 4.2 W (12 VDC); 9.2 W (PoE) (H.265 + WDR + warm light + intelligence on)
General.Anti-corrosion Level: Basic Protection *The products are designed for general use and are applicable even in areas with no specific requirements for anti-corrosion protection.
